item.title: Transformation E-Commerce
item.content:encoded:
This special issue focuses on how digital transformation is reshaping electronic commerce across industries. It seeks research that examines the adoption of emerging technologies, evolving business models, and innovative practices that enable organizations to compete effectively in an increasingly digital marketplace.

Appel publié par Electronic Commerce Research and Applications. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Digital transformation in e-commerce
  • Emerging technologies and e-commerce
  • Customer experience and digital innovation
  • Supply chain digitalization
  • Personalization and AI in e-commerce
  • Mobile commerce and omnichannel strategies
  • Data analytics and business intelligence
  • Cybersecurity in e-commerce
